Glossary
========


This glossary defines the terms and acronyms used throughout the
Eisenhower system and this documentation.

.. glossary::

   ABAC

      Attribute-Based Access Control — a security model that restricts data access based on user clearance levels and security caveats.

   BCR

      Baseline Change Request — a formal request to modify an approved project baseline.

   CDRL

      Contract Data Requirement List — a list of deliverables required by a contract.

   CPI

      Cost Performance Index — a measure of cost efficiency (EV/AC). Values below 1.0 indicate over-budget performance.

   CPM

      Critical Path Method — a scheduling algorithm that identifies the longest sequence of dependent tasks, determining the minimum project duration.

   CPR

      Cost Performance Report — a standard defence reporting format for programme cost data.

   DCMA 14-Point

      A 14-point schedule integrity checklist used by the Defence Contract Management Agency to validate project schedules.

   EAC

      Estimate at Completion — the predicted total cost of a project based on current performance.

   EV

      Earned Value — the value of work performed, expressed in monetary terms.

   EVM

      Earned Value Management — a project management technique that integrates scope, schedule, and cost to measure performance.

   Float

      The amount of time a task can be delayed without affecting the project completion date.

   IPMR

      Integrated Program Management Report — a comprehensive defence programme report combining scope, schedule, and cost data.

   PV

      Planned Value — the authorised budget for work scheduled to be completed by a given date.

   SCIF

      Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility — a secure room where classified information is handled.

   SPI

      Schedule Performance Index — a measure of schedule efficiency (EV/PV). Values below 1.0 indicate behind-schedule performance.

   UBN

      Universal Breakdown Node — the core data model that unifies work, resource, and location hierarchies.

   V&V

      Verification and Validation — the process of confirming that deliverables meet requirements.

   VAC

      Variance at Completion — the predicted total cost variance at project completion.

   WBS

      Work Breakdown Structure — a hierarchical decomposition of the total scope of work.

   WORM

      Write Once, Read Many — a storage model that prevents data modification after initial write, used for archival.

   defpack

      The encrypted data package format used for air-gap transfers between secure environments.

   ltree

      A PostgreSQL extension for storing and querying tree-structured data, used for the hierarchical project model.
